content_sections.heading: About the Institute
content_sections.text: The Indian Institute of Astrophysics is an autonomous academic national institution under the Department of Science & Technology, Govt. of India, dedicated to research in Astronomy, Astrophysics and Allied Sciences & Technology. Its main campus is in Koramangala, Bengaluru, with the CREST Campus at Hosakote, Bengaluru. It also operates field stations at Kavalur and Kodaikanal in Tamil Nadu, Gauribidanur in Karnataka, and Leh/Hanle in Ladakh.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: The notice invites applications for one post, Engineer Trainee (Electronics). The conditions below apply to that post. Full-time graduate Degree B.E./B.Tech in Electronics / Electronics and Communication Engineering / Electrical and Electronics Engineering / Instrumentation or equivalent degree with 60% marks in the aggregate or equivalent grade, from a reputed and recognized University/Institution under UGC or Central or State Governments. After graduation, minimum two (02) years of experience in Control Systems, Embedded systems, testing and troubleshooting telescope is preferred. Soldering and PCB Schematic design on Orcad, C/C++, Python. The age limit printed in the notice is 26 years. The date for determining the upper age limit, qualifications and experience is the date of the walk-in interview, 14.12.2026. Age relaxation is permissible to SC/ST/OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) candidates and also physically handicapped candidates, as notified by the Govt. of India from time to time. Only candidates of Indian nationality can attend the walk-in interview. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility details of the post.

content_sections.heading: IIA Engineer Trainee (Electronics) Job Description
content_sections.text: Development and Maintenance of telescope systems and allied equipment at Kodaikanal Solar Observatory, Kodaikanal.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Appointment
content_sections.text: There will be an annual increase of Rs. 2,500/- in the remuneration based on satisfactory performance. The appointment is purely on contract basis and does not entitle any privileges or service benefits applicable to regular employees of the Institute. No claim whatsoever for regular employment in the Institute shall be entertained. The tenure of traineeship is one year and extendable annually for four years (total five years of traineeship), subject to satisfactory performance of the candidate and requirement to the Project assessed annually. The selected candidate is liable to be posted anywhere in India as per the requirement of the Institute.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Candidates register their name between 09.00 AM and 10.00 AM on 14.12.2026. Candidates coming beyond this time will not be entertained. The Institute may conduct a written test to shortlist candidates for the walk-in interview if the attendance of candidates is more. The notice does not describe the interview in further detail.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be reimbursed for attending the walk-in interview. The Institute reserves the right to cancel the entire recruitment process at any time, or re-advertise if no candidate is found suitable, without assigning any reasons. The Institute reserves the right to increase/decrease the advertised vacancies subject to requirement of the project/institute. No correspondence will be entertained with candidates not selected for walk-in interview/appointment. Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification. Misrepresentation or falsification of facts, or misconduct/misbehavior at any stage of the selection process, will result in cancellation of candidature without any notice.

faq.question: Q1. When is the IIA Engineer Trainee (Electronics) walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 14.12.2026. Registration is between 09.00 AM and 10.00 AM, and candidates coming beyond this time will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q2. Where is the IIA walk-in interview held?
faq.answer: It is held at the IIA Campus, 2nd Block, Koramangala, Sarjapur Road, Bengaluru 560 034.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are there?
faq.answer: There is one (01) post of Engineer Trainee (Electronics), with Kodaikanal Solar Observatory (KSO), Kodaikanal as the place of posting.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for IIA Engineer Trainee (Electronics)?
faq.answer: A full-time graduate degree B.E./B.Tech in Electronics / Electronics and Communication Engineering / Electrical and Electronics Engineering / Instrumentation or equivalent, with 60% marks in the aggregate or equivalent grade.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The notice gives the age limit as 26 years, counted on the date of the walk-in interview, 14.12.2026. SC/ST/OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) and physically handicapped candidates get relaxation as notified by the Govt. of India.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of the IIA Engineer Trainee?
faq.answer: The remuneration is Rs. 30,000/- per month (Consolidated), with an annual increase of Rs. 2,500/- based on satisfactory performance.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I bring to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Bring the filled prescribed application with a passport size photograph pasted on top, original qualification and experience certificates and one set of self-certified photocopies. Also bring the original and one copy of CV, date of birth proof, experience certificates (if applicable) and ID proof (Aadhar, PAN, Driving License).

faq.question: Q8. Is the IIA Engineer Trainee job permanent?
faq.answer: No, the appointment is purely on contract basis. The traineeship is for one year, extendable annually for four years (total five years), subject to satisfactory performance and requirement of the Project assessed annually.

faq.question: Q9. Will a written test be held?
faq.answer: The Institute may conduct a written test to shortlist candidates for the walk-in interview if the attendance of candidates is more.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No, TA/DA will not be reimbursed for attending the walk-in interview.
